model_info.methodology: Persisted daily FFMC/DMC/DC accumulation per cell, with seasonal reinitialization on first run or after a gap of more than 3 days; falls back to replaying the 45-day weather window when no prior state exists for a cell.
model_info.algorithm: Pure CFWIS (Van Wagner, 1987) - No modifications to FWI output
model_info.seasonal_approach: Realistic initial fuel moisture codes based on seasonal weather patterns

notes.fwi_interpretation: FWI represents fire behavior potential (spread rate, intensity) if ignition occurs
notes.not_a_probability: FWI does NOT predict the probability of a fire starting
notes.danger_classes: FWI1987 danger class thresholds; exact class boundaries vary by provincial/territorial fire agency
notes.update_schedule: FWI: Daily at noon | Weather: Hourly
